function _envden_inside
  set -l directory $argv[2]
  while test -n "$directory"
    if test "$directory" -ef "$argv[1]"
      return 0
    end
    if test "$directory" = /
      break
    end
    set directory (string replace -r '/[^/]*$' '' -- "$directory")
    test -n "$directory"; or set directory /
  end
  return 1
end
function _envden_notice --on-variable PWD
  set -l saved_status $status
  set -l cache '/tmp/envden/state/notice'
  set -l physical (pwd -P)
  set -l approved 0
  if test -f '/tmp/envden/state/approved-checkouts'
    while read -l root
      if test -n "$root"; and _envden_inside "$root" "$physical"
        set approved 1
        break
      end
    end < '/tmp/envden/state/approved-checkouts'
  end
  set -l offered '/tmp/envden/state/track-offered'
  if test -f '/tmp/envden/state/track-offers'
    while read -l root
      if test -n "$root"; and _envden_inside "$root" "$physical"
        if not contains -- "$root" (cat -- "$offered" 2>/dev/null)
          printf '%s\n' 'envden: env files found; run envden track'
          printf '%s\n' "$root" >> "$offered"
        end
        break
      end
    end < '/tmp/envden/state/track-offers'
  end
  set -l day (date +%Y-%m-%d)
  if test -f '/tmp/envden/state/notice-update'
    while read -l line
      switch "$line"
        case 'envden: update required; run envden update'
          printf '%s\n' "$line"
        case 'envden: update available; run envden update'
          if test (cat -- '/tmp/envden/state/update-offered-day' 2>/dev/null; or echo missing) != "$day"
            printf '%s\n' "$line"
            printf '%s\n' "$day" > '/tmp/envden/state/update-offered-day'
          end
      end
    end < '/tmp/envden/state/notice-update'

    env LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176' < "$cache"

    disown
  end
